summary.title: To collect
summary.noPayment: There is no amount to collect yet. The payment is created when the client picks one of the published offers.
summary.waitingOnUsWarning: The client has already paid and is waiting on us. If nobody validates by {date}, the link expires and the case goes back to the queue.

proof.title: Client proof of payment
proof.empty: The client has not uploaded a proof of payment yet.
proof.declaredPaid: They declared payment on {date} via {method}, no file to open.

confirm.title: Confirm payment
confirm.paidNoTicket: Ticket not issued yet. This is the most critical state in the system: the client has paid and still has no ticket.
confirm.closedMoney: The case is closed on the money side.
confirm.diffEqual: Amount received matches the amount to collect. You can confirm.
confirm.diffOver: Received {amount} more than charged. Only confirm if you know why.
confirm.diffUnder: {amount} short. A partial payment does not release issuance, talk to the client before confirming.
confirm.checkboxTitle: I confirm the amount has reached WeeFly's account.
confirm.checkboxBody: I have seen the statement or the proof and recognise this case's payment. It is recorded under my name ({email}) and the case is released for issuance.
confirm.submit: Confirm payment and release for issuance
confirm.expiredNote: This link has already expired. For the client to pay again the payment must be reopened, the history keeps the attempt that died.
confirm.rejectLabel: Why it doesn't work: the client will read this
confirm.rejectPlaceholder: The proof is from another transfer / it has no reference / the amount doesn't match

deadline.title: Payment link deadline
deadline.body: The client's link doesn't stay open forever: the price they saw has an expiry. Without confirmation by the deadline, the payment expires on its own and the client sees the expired offers screen, with the button to request a new search.

instructions.title: Method chosen by the client
instructions.chooseForClient: If you agreed the method with the client by phone or WhatsApp, pick it here. It is recorded that the choice came from the back office.
instructions.clientChoseOther: The client chose {method}. Changing it here changes what they will see.
instructions.clientChoseHint: The method the client chose in the link.
instructions.dueAtHint: goes in the message to the client
instructions.createdByYou: The link or reference is created by you, in {method}, the platform doesn't generate them, it only stores and sends them. Make sure the amount charged is {amount}.
